simple: Access for contractors, vendors and remote administrators to critical systems without VPN, agents or passwords (formerly CyberArk Remote Access, Alero). A contractor signs in with biometric MFA on their own smartphone (scanning a one-time QR code), gets access only to the systems needed and only for the duration of the task, and connects through the browser in an isolated session — credentials never reach their device. Sessions are recorded with command-level audit; access is granted and revoked automatically when a contractor joins, changes role or finishes the contract; suspicious activity detection (ITDR) and discovery of forgotten contractor access are included. Sold only to Idira Privileged Access Manager SaaS or Self-Hosted customers: per vendor user or in packs by the number of registered users and monthly logins.
